conversation.content: ¿Podrías darme la letra completa de la última canción de Jay Chou?

message.content:
La última canción de Jay Chou (a fecha de hoy, 26 de Octubre de 2023) es **"最偉大的作品" (Zuì Wěidà de Zuòpǐn)**, que significa "La Obra Maestra". Aquí está la letra completa, con la romanización (pinyin) para ayudar a la pronunciación:

**最偉大的作品 (Zuì Wěidà de Zuòpǐn)**

**[Intro]**
喔 在哪個平行時空能遇見你
Ō zài nǎge píngxíng shíkōng néng yùjiàn nǐ
Oh, in which parallel time and space can I meet you?

**[Verse 1]**
誰說夢想 總會被現實敲碎
Shéi shuō mèngxiǎng zǒng huì bèi xiànshí qiāosuì
Who says dreams will always be shattered by reality?
最美的風景 是在回憶裡
Zuì měi de fēngjǐng shì zài huíyì lǐ
The most beautiful scenery is in memories
我用鋼琴 彈奏 我們的故事
Wǒ yòng gāngqín tánzòu wǒmen de gùshì
I play our story on the piano
當你轉身 消失在人海裡
Dāng nǐ zhuǎnshēn xiāoshī zài rénhǎi lǐ
When you turn around and disappear into the crowd

**[Chorus]**
最偉大的作品 是不完美的你
Zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn shì bù wánměi de nǐ
The greatest masterpiece is your imperfection
有你的缺點 才是最真實的自己
Yǒu nǐ de quēdiǎn cái shì zuì zhēnshí de zìjǐ
It's your flaws that make you the most authentic you
最偉大的作品 是時間帶走的回憶
Zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn shì shíjiān dàizǒu de huíyì
The greatest masterpiece is the memories time takes away
最偉大的作品 是我永遠愛你的心
Zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn shì wǒ yǒngyuǎn ài nǐ de xīn
The greatest masterpiece is my heart that will always love you

**[Verse 2]**
在每個路口 尋找你的足跡
Zài měi ge lùkǒu xúnzhǎo nǐ de zújì
Searching for your footprints at every intersection
曾經的誓言 如今聽起來多唏噓
Céngjīng de shìyán rújīn tīng qǐlái duō xīxū
The vows of the past sound so sorrowful now
我用畫筆 描繪 我們的回憶
Wǒ yòng huàbǐ miáohuì wǒmen de huíyì
I paint our memories with a brush
當你遠去 留下的空隙
Dāng nǐ yuǎnqù liú xià de kōngxì
When you leave, leaving a void

**[Chorus]**

The greatest masterpiece is your imperfection
有你的缺點 才是最真實的自己

Zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn shì wǒ yǒngyuǎn ài nǐ de xīn
The greatest masterpiece is my heart that will always love you

**[Bridge]**
時間會改變一切 卻無法改變我的愛
Shíjiān huì gǎibiàn yīqiè què wúfǎ gǎibiàn wǒ de ài
Time will change everything, but it can't change my love
就算世界崩塌 我也依然把你放在心懷
Jiùsuàn shìjiè bēngtā wǒ yě yīrán bǎ nǐ fàng zài xīnhuái
Even if the world collapses, I will still keep you in my heart

Zuì wěidà de zuòpǐn
The greatest masterpiece
